criteria: The executor classifies and justifies every finding that it changes or materially reports. It may omit opportunities in untouched code and does not need to inventory every requested dimension.

It applies at least one proportional, coherent improvement from the supported findings: establish one authoritative customer-key transformation, keep independently varying discount and fraud decisions separately understandable without hiding quote orchestration, remove the unused test-only production factory, or make the relationship operation's positions explicit without changing observable behavior. Any coherent subset is acceptable.

If it changes or materially reports the clock, it treats the clock as a genuine production dependency. If it changes Route.position_of, it states a separate concrete risk and completely preserves list.index identity, equality, duplicate, first-match, and ValueError semantics. Helper reuse by itself is not sufficient justification.
Alternative internal designs are acceptable when they satisfy the classifications and preserve all public behavior; no particular helper, traversal, policy object, or topology is required.
It avoids gratuitous patterns, changes only cohesion.py, keeps tests unchanged, and leaves the public suite green, including the non-reflexive equality and not-found scenarios.
